# Sam Gilson

Sam Gilson is a PhD student in computer science at North Carolina State University. His work examines generative AI help-seeking, AI literacy, and undergraduate discrete mathematics.

## Research
- [Research and publications](https://sgilson7.github.io/publications/): Published papers and posters, preprints, work under review, and talks are labeled separately.
- [Dissertation research](https://sgilson7.github.io/dissertation/): Research direction and current work.
- [AIED case study](https://sgilson7.github.io/papers/gilson2026perturbation/): Eight students’ chatbot interactions; online release in 2026, publisher citation year 2027.
- [Classroom-study preprint](https://sgilson7.github.io/papers/gilson-summer2026/): Ongoing analysis; submitted to the SIGCSE TS 2027 Student Research Competition.
- [MATH manuscript](https://sgilson7.github.io/papers/gilson-math-benchmark/): Under review; no public manuscript or formal publication record on this site.
- [Citations](https://sgilson7.github.io/publications.bib): BibTeX for public research records and the lecture.

## Concepts and teaching
- [Concepts](https://sgilson7.github.io/concepts/): Definitions distinguish established constructs from local study and teaching labels.
- [Teaching](https://sgilson7.github.io/teaching/): Courses and teaching approach.
